source_correspondence: Vasy wave Proposition 6.2 retains the sharp s+1 forcing threshold, large epsilon then small delta, and common-neighborhood bootstrap.
Its weak Neumann proof uses actual H1 test functions and the natural antidual, not strong conormal preservation by localized inputs.
The forms framework allows variable Lorentzian metrics and differential plus Banach-adjoint lower terms. The nonselfadjoint equality (5.10) is not imported unchanged.
The edge notes describe complex first-order matrix absorption by enlarging the cutoff derivative relative to its amplitude. Our proof retains all lower-form terms explicitly.
The correction concerns glancing localization; its epsilon/delta scale is not substituted for the hyperbolic large-epsilon scale.
